_readme: The seam map, read by the hooks. Every code file in src/, contracts/, and mocks/ must be listed under exactly one seam. buildOrder: config, auth, state first, then dependency-free seams, working outward. Status: blueprint/contract/tests are true|false; mockGreen/realGreen are a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null. A seam with no mock has nothing to flip.

seams.name: config
seams.description: All settings and secrets, read and validated in one place (src/config/).
failureScreens: Missing setting: app refuses to start and names the setting

seams.name: auth
seams.description: Who the user is: sign in, sign out, session expiry.

seams.name: state
seams.description: Shared app state every screen reads (current user, current project, etc.).

seams.name: storage
seams.description: Saving and loading user data and files (database + file storage). See plan/MIGRATION.md.

seams.name: example-feature
seams.description: Replace with a real feature seam (e.g. image generation, catalog, closet screens).
